title: IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty 17.0.0.3 through 26.0.0.10 could allow an authenticated user with the Reader…
description: IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty versions 17.0.0.3 through 26.0.0.10 contain a vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user with the Reader role to access sensitive information. The vulnerability does not affect integrity or availability but impacts confidentiality. The CVSS score is 6.5, indicating a medium severity level. No patch or remediation information is provided in the available data.
